This '''conference room''' was located on the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller'']]. It was there where [[Wraith Squadron]] usually debriefed after missions during the campaign against [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]].<ref name="WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>
